description: Connect your settlement events: send a payout provider's settlement event (provider, payout_id, from, to, amount_sent, quoted_rate, fee, amount_settled, settled_at, rail, status) and get a signed landing receipt. The quote is checked against the official rate of the settlement day and the market reads nearest to it (exchange order books, P2P adverts; NGN quotes above the official rate are labelled, not refused); what settled is set against what was quoted, in money and percent; flags say when it landed short, failed or was returned; the receipt carries an Ed25519 signature (verify at POST https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/attestations/verify). Stored append-only for your organisation; the monthly summary per provider is GET https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/landing-receipts/summary?provider=...&month=YYYY-MM. Needs a router key. The same call is POST https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/landing-receipts. SwapEazi never touches the money.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

amount_sent.description: Amount sent, in the source currency, e.g. 25000.

amount_settled.description: What the recipient was credited, in the destination currency, e.g. 38630000.

fee.description: The fee in the source currency, charged on top, e.g. 2.5.

from.description: ISO code of the currency sent, e.g. USD.

payout_id.description: The provider's payout id, e.g. po_3f81c9.

quoted_rate.description: The rate the provider quoted, destination units per source unit, e.g. 1545.20.

settled_at.description: When it settled, ISO 8601 with time zone, e.g. 2026-11-19T14:02:11Z.

to.description: ISO code of the currency credited, e.g. NGN.

name: record_settlement
title: Record a payout's settlement event
